questions: What is consideration?
If consideration is never given, does the promise still bind?
What is acceptance?
Once acceptance is sent, can it still be taken back?
What counts as notice?
If a notice is never read, has it still taken effect?
What does delivery mean?
If delivery never arrives, has ownership still changed?
What is a discharge?
After a discharge, is anything still owed?
What is an assignment?
If an assignment is passed on, is the first person still responsible?
What makes a gift complete?
If a gift is taken back, does it belong to the giver again?
What is a remedy?
If the remedy works, is the harm undone?
What counts as performance?
If a performance stops halfway, does the other side still have to pay?
What is a release?
Once a release is out, can it be pulled back?
What is a trust?
If trust is broken, does it end?
What is a title?
If the title changes, does the owner change too?
What is a nuisance?
If the nuisance stops, is the harm already over?
What is fault?
If the fault is fixed, does that end what is owed?
What is a bond?
If the bond is broken, does the obligation vanish?
